name: fake-upstream smoke
description: Deterministic harness check: a model drives the gateway against the bundled fake upstream. Not a quality benchmark of real upstreams.

tasks.prompt: Read the file README.md from owner acme and repo demo using the gateway. Reply with only the path you passed.
How many upstream tools does this gateway expose? Use the sandbox to inspect the tool list, then reply with only the number.
Search code with the query retryPolicy. Reply with only the query string that reached the upstream.
Use search with select: to fetch the full schema of the notion__notion-search tool. Is its query parameter required or optional? Reply with one word.
Call a tool named github__does_not_exist through the gateway and report the exact error message you get. Keep the report short.

checks.regex: not a function|unknown tool|does not exist
